title: B2 Milestone 3: Review Test
completion_message: ¡Felicidades! Has superado el Tercer Hito del Nivel B2. Tu capacidad de deducción, análisis de marketing y liderazgo te posicionan como un ejecutivo integral.

parts.visual:
En esta prueba repasaremos las lecciones 11 a 14 del nivel B2: 
- Participle Clauses (Having signed, Walking). 
- Modales de Deducción (He must have done it, They might have won).
parts.audio: In this test we will review lessons 11 to 14 of the B2 level: Participle Clauses, and Modals of Deduction.

parts.visual:
También repasaremos vocabulario avanzado: 
- Marketing & Branding (Brand awareness, market share, target audience). 
- Liderazgo (Delegate, empower, micromanage, accountability). 
¡Demuestra tus habilidades ejecutivas!
parts.audio: We will also review advanced vocabulary: Marketing & Branding, and Leadership. Show your executive skills!

stages.title: Milestone Quiz
stages.description: Elige la respuesta correcta en este desafío integrador B2.

questions.question: ____ the contract, we went out to celebrate. (Habiendo firmado).
____ in China, the electronics are very affordable. (Fabricados).
The boss is furious. Someone ____ leaked the information to the press. (Seguro que ha).
She was with me all day yesterday. She ____ stolen the laptop! (Es imposible que haya).
questions.explanation: Couldn't have (certeza de que NO pasó).

questions.question: We need an advertising campaign to build brand ____. (Reconocimiento).
What is our company's ____? Why should people buy from us? (Propuesta única de venta).
Our new product went ____ on social media. (Viral).
A good manager doesn't do everything. They ____ tasks. (Delegan).
I don't like my boss because he tries to ____ every little thing I do. (Microgestionar).
There needs to be more ____. People must take responsibility for their errors. (Rendición de cuentas).
____ out of money, the company had to close. (Habiéndose quedado).
____ tired, I decided to go home early. (Sintiéndome).
They didn't win the contract. They ____ offered a terrible price. (Seguro que).
You sent that email 1 minute ago. They ____ read it yet. (Es imposible que).
Our growth mainly comes from ____ of mouth. (Boca a boca).
We are targeting a very specific ____ market. (Nicho).
We want to ____ our employees to make decisions. (Empoderar).
The CEO has an open-____ policy. (Puertas abiertas).
We need to ____ a culture of innovation. (Fomentar).
I don't know where my phone is. I ____ left it at the office. (Tal vez haya).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra clave del nivel B2.

questions.question: ____ signed, we left. (Habiendo)
____ in China. (Fabricado con M)
He ____ have known! (Seguro que - modal)
She ____ have stolen it! (Es imposible - modal)
Brand ____. (Reconocimiento con A)
____ of mouth. (Boca a boca con W)
To ____ tasks. (Delegar con D)
To ____ the team. (Empoderar con E)
Build ____. (Rendición de cuentas con A)
Don't ____. (Microgestionar con M)
